cohort: 1057 women with PHPT and 3171 age- and gender-matched controls in Denmark
finding: A diagnosis of PHPT did not appear to increase the rate of abortions or affect birth weight, length, or Apgar score, but it was associated with lower gestation length and a higher rate of cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Women with PHPT had lower gestation length within the first year after diagnosis, but this was linked to more deliveries by cesarean sections.
